content.text:
I'm examining the border colors around the square, checking rows and columns for a repeating pattern like alternating values, but the numbers don't line up cleanly yet.

Checking majorities per side, 3 dominates on right and bottom while top leans toward alternation but ties out. Given the noise, treating the whole border as uniform 3 seems like the cleanest fit, so I'll go with that.
